Records from the Odd Sympathy conversations (the invention prompt as received, the revision's six simulation scripts, the build-stage rule check, confirmed authorship and chronology) are added to that archive by jstewdios/collaborative-instruments PR #3; the scripts' original printed outputs were not preserved.

files.from: Original script section '// ---------- the three rules ----------'
files.modified: Moved into a DOM-free class. Arithmetic, constants and evaluation order unchanged. tests/odd-sympathy/model.test.mjs runs the preserved original's own code beside it and requires identical fire times and pitches for all six setups, with player edits.
Geometry unchanged and checked against the original. The crowd setup accepts an injectable random source for testing.

Voice, filter envelope, panning, generated reverb, limiter and the 42-voice cap unchanged. Added: an output gate after the limiter for mute and lifecycle, gesture-only start, visible failure with retry, background suspension without automatic recovery, and full close on navigation.

Drawing unchanged except: reduced motion now also drops expanding ripples and lurch trails (shown instead as a brief rim brightening); a dashed halo marks the keyboard-focused ring; labels use the bundled DM Sans.

files.from: Original script sections for touch & mouse, hints, drawer and start
files.modified: Gestures, thresholds, hint sequence and ring limit unchanged. Coordinates are now relative to the field below the collection bar, and rings and ripples are remapped proportionally when the field resizes. Added: keyboard play, a Sound button, clock mapping that pauses instead of catching up, pointer-capture loss handling, and page lifecycle cleanup.

Added collection navigation, Sound button, keyboard ring targets, an About section and an audio error with retry. Intro text unchanged. One drawer sentence corrected: 'The triangle can never settle' became 'The triangle splits two against one' (see docs/ODD_SYMPATHY.md).
Same palette and layout. Display font falls back to the original's own serif stack; body text uses the bundled DM Sans instead of Karla. 44px controls and safe-area spacing added.
